title: Scoped Execution Enablement Tool Implementation
claim: FP-MCP-305 implemented the MCP bridge scoped execution enablement tool surface: preview, create, and status tools for a short-lived exact-tuple local enablement artifact. The implementation is committed in the MCP bridge at 36c3d5a, tests pass, and no guarded run was attempted.
summary: The MCP bridge repository feature/oauth-auth0 advanced from d45e9cc to 36c3d5a with commit 'Add scoped execution enablement tools'. The change adds src/operator-local-enablement.ts and registers three tools: forgepilot_preview_operator_local_scoped_execution_enablement_review_manifest, forgepilot_create_operator_local_scoped_execution_enablement, and forgepilot_get_operator_local_scoped_execution_enablement_status. The tool logic validates exact request scope, current clean repository state, request artifact commit binding, existing local clearance eligibility and clearanceId match, pre-start evidence hash, start-state snapshot attempt and hashes, and a recent runner capability timestamp. The create path writes only the local gitignored enablement artifact and self-validates it. Server wrappers validate the human approval artifact before reporting or creating enablement. pnpm build passed. pnpm test initially failed only because new descriptions included a hardcoded packet id string; that wording was corrected and pnpm test passed.
caveats: Implementation is in the MCP bridge repository, not the ForgePilot core repository.
